stories.title: Shaka Santa, Tutu Mele arrive at Honolulu Hale
stories.summary: City crews installed Shaka Santa and Tutu Mele in their customary spot on the fountain at Honolulu Hale.

stories.title: Land board approves settlement with owners of grounded yacht that damaged Maui marine sanctuary
stories.summary: The BLNR approved a $375,000 settlement with Kevin and Kimberly Albert and the Albert Revocable Trust for damages to Honolua Bay.

stories.title: Actor Patrick Stewart’s cause of death revealed
stories.summary: ‘Star Trek’ actor Patrick Stewart’s cause of death has been released.

stories.title: Suspect in deadly Kalihi mini mart stabbing enters plea
stories.summary: Alexis Aquino, 23, pleaded not guilty to one count of second-degree murder and a first-degree robbery charge.

stories.title: Honolulu EMS graduates 13 EMTs, 4 emergency medical dispatchers
stories.summary: They will join the department in its mission to save lives and provide emergency care to Oahu.

stories.title: Brush fire reported in Kihei
stories.summary: A brush fire was reported in Kiehi at 12:6 p.m. near the intersection of Piikea Ave. and S. Kihei Rd. between Uluniu Rd and S. Kihei Rd.

stories.title: Trump administration auctions seabed mining rights despite judge’s ruling
stories.summary: On Thursday, $6 million in leases were awarded to bidders for 31 million acres of the sea floor off the waters of American Samoa.

stories.title: 14-year-old’s death ruled homicide after alleged online manipulation and extortion, authorities say
stories.summary: The death of a 14-year-old Indiana girl has been ruled a homicide after authorities said she was subjected to psychological manipulation and extortion by an outside actor.

stories.title: Trump warns U.S. companies against building data centers overseas
stories.summary: President Donald Trump warned U.S. companies that want to build data centers overseas that they will face what he called a “tremendous tax.”

stories.title: Man honored for finding missing toddler 2 miles from home, curled up in bush and shivering
stories.summary: A 2-year-old girl who went missing Tuesday night in Arizona was found 2 miles from her home.

stories.title: 16-year-old boy accused of killing his twin brother, police say
stories.summary: A 16-year-old is charged with murder in his twin brother’s shooting death in Washington, D.C. Their mother says the shooting was an accident.

stories.title: Man who filed for divorce 2 weeks ago now accused of killing his wife, police say
stories.summary: A Nebraska man who had filed for divorce is accused of killing his wife Wednesday night.
